gaps.explanation: p4 Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds: the 'Grants and donations' row prints General 499,170 + Street 46,576 + Swimming Pool - + Other Governmental 10,318 = 556,064, but its Total Governmental Funds cell prints 566,064 (10,000 too high; the p2 Statement of Activities also gives 556,064). The printed Total receipts is 2,232,434, which equals the schedule total. The JSON statement receipt line 'Grants and donations' 566,064 (p4) is the mis-added Total cell, so the JSON statement lines sum to 2,242,434 instead of the printed 2,232,434. Detail (fund columns) is correct; no detail fix.

p4 'Interfund transfer in (out)': General 142,823, Street (25,657), Swimming Pool -, Other Governmental (45,937); Total Governmental Funds column prints the net 71,229 (statement transfers_in 71,229, transfers_out null). Detail records the fund columns gross: in 142,823 (General), out 25,657 + 45,937 = 71,594. 142,823 - 71,594 = 71,229. The -71,594 gap is only the statement's netting of the intra-governmental transfers; no fix.

p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position - Business-Type Activities: 'Repairs and maintenance' prints Light 51,929 + Water 78,344 + Sewer 92,475 + Recycle - = 222,748, but its Total cell prints 227,748 (5,000 too high). Printed Total operating expenses 1,825,278 (= 1,212,405 + 352,351 + 260,404 + 118) + Interest expense and loan fees 5,975 = 1,831,253 = schedule total. The JSON statement disbursement line 'Repairs and maintenance' 227,748 (p6) is the mis-added Total cell, so the JSON statement lines sum to 1,836,253. Detail (fund columns) is correct; no detail fix.
